plan.title: fix(release): Step 5 releaseCheckEnv poisons vitest — forces --skip-ci on production cuts (recurrence of #1553 after #2386)

narratives.Description: This story implements the cited GitHub issue acceptance criteria in the scoped packages listed in swarm.file_scope. It includes regression tests and a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased Fixed or Changed as appropriate.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

`task release` / `directive release` Step 5 (`runReleaseCheck` → `releaseCheckEnv`) injects `DEFT_ALLOW_DEFAULT_BRANCH_COMMIT=1` and `DEFT_RELEASE_PREFLIGHT=1` into the entire `task check` / vitest process tree. Nested tests that assert fail-closed branch policy or cache staleness then see `source=env-bypass` / soft-pass and fail falsely. On the **v0.74.0** cut this blocked Step 5 and forced `--skip-ci` for the production tag.

This is a recurrence of the #1553 class (env bypass leaking into nested tests), reintroduced by the #2386 Step 5 self-auth path that intentionally sets those vars for `verify:branch` / `verify:cache-fresh` tolerance on master.

## Observed on v0.74.0 (2026-07-10)

Step 5 failed with ~13 false failures, including:

- `packages/cli/src/verify-branch.test.ts` — expected exit 1 on default branch, got 0
- `packages/cli/src/gates-cli/policy-cli.test.ts` — expected `Branch-protection policy is ON`, got `source=env-bypass`
- `packages/core/src/policy/resolve.test.ts` — expected `source=typed`, got `env-bypass`
- `packages/core/src/events/attribution-ledger.test.ts` — branch gate expected exit 1, got 0
- `packages/core/src/preflight-cache/evaluate.test.ts` — stale-cache cases expected exit 1, got 0 (softened by `DEFT_RELEASE_PREFLIGHT`)

The same suites pass when run **without** the release Step 5 env. E2E rehearsal (`release-e2e`, including npm dry-run) was green. Production cut proceeded with `--skip-ci` after that confidence check.

## Root cause (current shape)

`packages/core/src/release/preflight.ts` `releaseCheckEnv()` spreads `releaseSubprocessEnv()` (sets `DEFT_ALLOW_DEFAULT_BRANCH_COMMIT=1`) and adds `DEFT_RELEASE_PREFLIGHT=1`, then passes that env into `dispatchTaskCheck`. Vitest inherits the parent env, so fixture repos cannot exercise fail-closed behavior.

Typed `plan.policy.allowDirectCommitsToMaster=true` (the preferred #1553 release-session path) already satisfies the branch gate for the real checkout; the env bypass is redundant for that surface and harmful for nested tests.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Step 5 can run a full framework `task check` on master during an authorized release without false vitest failures from inherited bypass env
- [ ] Branch-gate / cache-staleness unit tests still fail closed when their fixtures expect blocking (no ambient `DEFT_ALLOW_DEFAULT_BRANCH_COMMIT` / `DEFT_RELEASE_PREFLIGHT` in the test process)
- [ ] Release session still authorizes default-branch commit/tag/push (typed policy and/or scoped subprocess env on **git mutation** steps only — not the whole check tree)
- [ ] Regression test: running Step 5's check path (or a documented equivalent) does not leave `DEFT_ALLOW_DEFAULT_BRANCH_COMMIT` / `DEFT_RELEASE_PREFLIGHT` set in the vitest worker env
- [ ] Release skill / RELEASING.md no longer need `--skip-ci` as the workaround for this class

## Suggested direction (non-binding)

Prefer typed `policy:allow-direct-commits` for the release session (already documented) and keep `releaseSubprocessEnv` scoped to commit/tag/push only. For Step 5 cache tolerance, either (a) pass `DEFT_RELEASE_PREFLIGHT` only to the cache-fresh gate subprocess, not the whole check tree, or (b) teach the check orchestrator a release-preflight flag that does not rely on process-wide env inherited by vitest.

## Refs

- Refs #1553 (documented env-bypass leak into nested tests)
- Refs #2386 (Step 5 self-auth / `DEFT_RELEASE_PREFLIGHT` — closed; this is the follow-on recurrence)
- Observed during `deft-directive-release` cut of **v0.74.0**
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
Edit these concrete paths: packages/core/src/ts-check-lane/run-lane.ts, packages/core/src/ts-check-lane/run-lane.test.ts, packages/core/src/ts-check-lane/index.ts, CHANGELOG.md. Verify with: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/ts-check-lane/run-lane.test.ts. 1. Add sanitizeTsLaneEnv that strips DEFT_ALLOW_DEFAULT_BRANCH_COMMIT and DEFT_RELEASE_PREFLIGHT.
2. Apply it in the default pnpm spawn for ts:check-lane so vitest never inherits release Step-5 poison env.
3. Keep releaseCheckEnv for live verify:branch / verify:cache-fresh siblings.
4. Add unit tests for sanitize + CHANGELOG; close #2434 and duplicate #2469.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer cutting a release, I want Step 5 task check to stay green without --skip-ci, so that production tags are not blocked by false vitest failures.

items.title: Strip poison env from TS lane spawn

narrative.Acceptance: Given release Step-5 env is set, when ts:check-lane spawns pnpm/vitest, then DEFT_ALLOW_DEFAULT_BRANCH_COMMIT and DEFT_RELEASE_PREFLIGHT are absent from the child env.
Given branch/cache unit tests expect blocking, when they run under a poisoned parent env, then they still observe fail-closed behavior because the lane sanitized the child env.

items.title: Release check still authorizes live gates

narrative.Acceptance: Given runReleaseCheck, when check:framework-source runs, then verify:branch and verify:cache-fresh still see the release tolerance flags.
